text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B, C, A and D while they were above my average costs, but a gain by itself is not a sound reason to sell; I should consider each holding's role and prospects.","My average cost is a reference point, not a measure of current value. I should not cling to losing positions to avoid regret or sell winners just to feel satisfied locking in gains.","I made no trades for seven straight periods while the account value rose overall. Since past price moves do not predict future ones, I should review deliberately and trade only when it serves my portfolio—not out of habit or inaction."]}
